def reverse_substring(s: str, start: int, end: int) -> str:
    # Check if the indices are out of bounds
    if start < 0 or end >= len(s) or start > end:
        return s
    
    # Extract the substring to be reversed
    substring = s[start:end+1]
    
    # Reverse the substring
    reversed_substring = substring[::-1]
    
    # Replace the original substring with the reversed one
    return s[:start] + reversed_substring + s[end+1:]
